title: Hearty Achievements
description: Hearty Achievements is a Fabric mod for 1.21.4 that changes health based on advancements.
body:
#### Hearty Achievements is a Fabric mod for 1.21.4 that changes health based on advancements.

• Players start with 1 HP (half a heart)
• Task = +1 HP
• Challenge = +3 HP
• Goal = +5 HP

Multiplayer supported.

Commands:
- /ha on
- /ha off
- /ha config task <value>
- /ha config challenge <value>
- /ha config goal <value>

All settings are saved per-world in Game Rules.

----------RU------------ 
#### Hearty Achievements — мод Fabric для 1.21.4, который меняет здоровье за достижения.

• Стартовое здоровье: 1 HP (полсердца)
• Задача = +1 HP
• Испытание = +3 HP
• Цель = +5 HP

Работает в мультиплеере.

Команды:
- /ha on
- /ha off
- /ha config task <value>
- /ha config challenge <value>
- /ha config goal <value>

Все настройки сохраняются в правилах мира.
